0.name: Work and Force

1.name: Thermal Energy Calculations
1.description: These problems involve calculating the energy required for temperature changes and phase transitions in substances like water, ice, and steam.

3.name: Human Biology Basics
3.description: These questions focus on fundamental aspects of human biology, including anatomy, physiology, and comparative biology.

4.name: Hardy-Weinberg
4.description: These problems focus on genetic frequencies and inheritance patterns in populations using principles of Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium.

5.name: Kinematics
5.description: These problems involve the study of motion, including velocity, acceleration, and displacement, often requiring integration or differentiation to solve.

6.name: Magnetic Force and Fields
6.description: These problems involve calculating magnetic forces on current-carrying wires and determining magnetic fields in various configurations such as solenoids and coils.

7.name: Gas Laws
7.description: These problems involve the application of gas laws to calculate properties such as pressure, volume, temperature, and number of moles of gases.

8.name: Molar Mass Calculations
8.description: These problems involve calculating the mass of substances based on moles, number of atoms or molecules, and molar masses of elements and compounds.

9.name: Stoichiometry
9.description: These problems involve calculating the amounts of reactants and products in chemical reactions using mole ratios and molar masses.

10.name: Mechanical Design
10.description: These problems focus on the design and analysis of mechanical components under various loading conditions, including stress, strain, failure criteria, and material properties.

11.name: Wave Optics
11.description: These problems involve the behavior of light waves in interference, diffraction, and refraction phenomena.

12.name: Electric Fields
12.description: These problems focus on calculating electric fields due to point charges, including magnitude, direction, and net field at specific points.

13.name: Orbital Mechanics
13.description: These problems involve calculating orbital parameters, gravitational forces, and motion of celestial bodies in space.

15.name: Electrical Circuits
15.description: These problems involve the analysis of electrical circuits, including capacitors, resistors, inductors, and AC/DC behavior.

16.name: Solution Concentration
16.description: These problems focus on calculating concentrations, molarities, and masses of solutes in solutions.

17.name: Equilibrium Calculations
17.description: These problems involve calculating equilibrium constants (Kc or Kp) for chemical reactions using given concentrations, dissociation percentages, or initial conditions.

18.name: Energy and Motion
18.description: These problems involve the application of energy conservation, work, friction, and motion principles in various physical scenarios.

19.name: DNA and Respiration
19.description: These questions focus on the structure and composition of DNA, nucleotide percentages, and the quantitative aspects of cellular respiration processes.
